payload.core_mechanism_summary: Computes probability by counting paths ending in middle cup; uses parity and modular exponentiation of 2 to evaluate closed-form formula derived from Markov chain recurrence.
payload.rationale: Original solution code is I/O boilerplate without core logic; TACO tags suggest DP counting. The problem reduces to a simple combinatorial formula after deriving recurrence, fitting dp_counting_combinatorics weakly.
